label: Right common iliac artery
synonyms: Trunk of right common iliac arterial tree

tier1.text: The common iliac arteries carry blood to the pelvis and on to the legs. The aorta, the body's largest artery, ends by splitting into the two common iliac arteries. Each common iliac artery then splits into an internal and an external branch.
